<!-- Source page: LightDM -->

[LightDM](https://github.com/canonical/lightdm) is a lightweight, cross-desktop display manager. It is built on X11 but is capable of launching Wayland sessions.

## Installation

LightDM may be installed and set to start automatically by enabling it in your configuration file.

## Configuration

Additional options may be found under [services.xserver.displayManager.lightdm](https://mynixos.com/nixpkgs/options/services.xserver.displayManager.lightdm).
